fields.description:
Mirror Partner's Agreement set onto Operator so Direct relationships carry their own terms and signed contract.

=== FIELDS ===

* Agreement Signed — Date

* Renewal Date — Date

* Notice Period — Text, free form (Joyce, Slack Aug 14 14:32: 'Feel free to make them free form text for now'). NOT a picklist — reverses Taryn's doc.

* Auto-Renew — Checkbox

* Exclusivity — Text, free form — same Slack answer. NOT a picklist.

* Agreement File — Salesforce Files, stored in Salesforce not Drive/GCP

=== IMPLEMENTATION REQUIREMENTS ===

* Part of the same Direct-only conditional group as Billing — visibility is BUILD-130, not here.

* Salesforce Files, confirmed Aug 13: Kobi 'do we need that stored in Google Drive? Or is it okay to store it in Salesforce?' -> 'Salesforce. Salesforce, fine.' Joyce: 'the amount of agreements are not so huge that we need to solution otherwise.' GCP stays scoped to Sign-Up proofs.

* Do not mark any field required on the page layout. No validation rules are being built yet — decided 2026-08-17: 'No need for validations for now, we'll add them in later as needed.'

=== OPEN QUESTIONS ===

* Taryn reported Operator as 'pretty much' complete but did not enumerate the Agreement fields specifically. Verify these six exist before closing.

=== NOTES ===

* ALREADY BUILT (verify — see open question). Confirmed on the Aug 17 Kobi/Taryn call. Ticket is retroactive documentation.

* Settles OP-3's open question. Joyce: 'if the relationship is direct, then we should also have the same agreement information on operators that we did on partners.' She thought they already existed; Kobi corrected her — 'They're not. Not for the agreement.'

=== SOURCE ===

* Taryn doc OP-3

* Aug 13 call

* Slack Joyce Aug 14 14:32

Dependencies: BUILD-126

Owner (proposed): Taryn Reithofer

Remember to update the requirements documentation as part of this change.

Created 2026-08-17 from the Operator/Partner ticket review, approved by Kobi.
